create_ad.description: Create an ad in an ad set from a creative you have already made. New ads go through Meta's review before they can deliver, and are created paused unless you choose otherwise.
create_ad.name: create_ad

parameters.description: The ad account the ad set belongs to.
parameters.name: ad_account_id

parameters.description: The ad set to create the ad in.
parameters.name: ad_set_id

parameters.description: The ad's name, as shown in Ads Manager.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The creative this ad runs, as returned by Create an ad creative or List ad creatives.
parameters.name: creative_id

parameters.description: The status to create the ad in. Only Active and Paused are allowed at creation.
parameters.name: status

create_ad_creative.description: Create a link ad creative from one of your Facebook Pages: a message, a destination URL and an optional headline. Meta builds the preview image from the link.
create_ad_creative.name: create_ad_creative

parameters.description: The ad account to save the creative in.
parameters.name: ad_account_id

parameters.description: A name for the creative, used to find it later in Ads Manager.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The Page the ad is published as. Pick one of your Pages, or paste a Page id.
parameters.name: page_id

parameters.description: The ad's primary text, shown above the image.
parameters.name: message

parameters.description: Where the ad sends people, for example, https://example.com/spring.
parameters.name: link

parameters.description: An optional headline shown under the image. Leave empty to let Meta use the page's own title.
parameters.name: link_title

create_ad_set.description: Create an ad set under a campaign, with its own daily budget and country targeting. New ad sets are created paused unless you choose otherwise.
create_ad_set.name: create_ad_set

parameters.description: The ad account the campaign belongs to.
parameters.name: ad_account_id

parameters.description: The campaign to create the ad set under.
parameters.name: campaign_id

parameters.description: The ad set's name, as shown in Ads Manager.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The most this ad set may spend per day, in the ad account's own currency: 25 means twenty-five dollars on a USD account.
parameters.name: daily_budget

parameters.description: What Meta charges for.
parameters.name: billing_event

parameters.description: What Meta optimizes delivery for.
parameters.name: optimization_goal

parameters.description: The countries to target, as two-letter codes such as US, GB or DE. At least one is required.
parameters.name: countries

parameters.description: The status to create the ad set in.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: How Meta bids. Lowest cost without cap lets Meta bid for you and needs no bid cap; the other two require one.
parameters.name: bid_strategy

parameters.description: The most to pay per billing event, in the account's currency. Required for Lowest cost with bid cap and Cost cap; leave empty for Lowest cost without cap.
parameters.name: bid_amount

parameters.description: When the ad set should start delivering. Leave empty to start as soon as it is active.
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description: When the ad set should stop delivering. Leave empty to run until you pause it.
parameters.name: end_time

create_campaign.description: Create a campaign in an ad account. New campaigns are created paused unless you choose otherwise, so nothing starts spending before you have added an ad set and an ad.
create_campaign.name: create_campaign

parameters.description: The ad account to create the campaign in.
parameters.name: ad_account_id

parameters.description: The campaign's name, as shown in Ads Manager.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What the campaign optimizes for. This cannot be changed after the campaign is created.
parameters.name: objective

parameters.description: The status to create the campaign in.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Declare a regulated category if the ads promote housing, employment, credit, or social issues, elections and politics. Choose None for anything else: Meta requires the declaration either way.
parameters.name: special_ad_categories

parameters.description: An optional daily budget in the ad account's own currency, for example, 25 for twenty-five dollars. Leave empty to set budgets on the ad sets instead.
parameters.name: daily_budget

parameters.description: How inventory is bought. Auction is the default and is what almost every campaign uses.
parameters.name: buying_type

parameters.description: Only applies when you leave the daily budget empty and set budgets on the ad sets instead. Turn it on to let Meta move up to 20% of one ad set's budget to another in the same campaign. Off keeps each ad set to its own budget.
parameters.name: share_budget_across_ad_sets

delete_ad.description: Delete an ad. This cannot be undone: pause it instead if you may want it back.
delete_ad.name: delete_ad

parameters.description: The ad to delete.
parameters.name: ad_id

delete_ad_set.description: Delete an ad set and the ads inside it. This cannot be undone: pause it instead if you may want it back.
delete_ad_set.name: delete_ad_set

parameters.description: The ad set to delete.
parameters.name: ad_set_id

delete_campaign.description: Delete a campaign along with every ad set and ad inside it. This cannot be undone: pause the campaign instead if you may want it back.
delete_campaign.name: delete_campaign

parameters.description: The campaign to delete.
parameters.name: campaign_id

get_account_insights.description: Read impressions, reach, clicks, CTR and spend for a whole ad account over a chosen window, optionally broken out per campaign, ad set or ad.
get_account_insights.name: get_account_insights

parameters.description: The ad account to report on.
parameters.name: ad_account_id

parameters.description: The reporting window. Defaults to the last 30 days.
parameters.name: date_preset

parameters.description: How finely to cut the rows: one row for the account, or one per campaign, ad set or ad.
parameters.name: level

parameters.description: Optionally split each row by a dimension, such as age or country.
parameters.name: breakdown

parameters.description: How many rows to return (1-500). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: max_results

date_preset.description: The reporting window the figures cover.

get_ad_set.description: Read one ad set's budget, schedule, optimization goal and the countries it targets.
get_ad_set.name: get_ad_set

parameters.description: The ad set to read, as returned by List ad sets.
parameters.name: ad_set_id

get_campaign.description: Read one campaign's objective, status, budget and schedule.
get_campaign.name: get_campaign

parameters.description: The campaign to read, as returned by List campaigns, for example, 23851234567890123.
parameters.name: campaign_id

get_campaign_insights.description: Read impressions, reach, clicks, CTR and spend for one campaign over a chosen window, optionally broken out per ad set or ad.
get_campaign_insights.name: get_campaign_insights

parameters.description: The campaign to report on.
parameters.name: campaign_id

parameters.description: The reporting window. Defaults to the last 30 days.
parameters.name: date_preset

parameters.description: How finely to cut the rows: one row for the campaign, or one per ad set or ad.
parameters.name: level

parameters.description: Optionally split each row by a dimension, such as age or country.
parameters.name: breakdown

parameters.description: How many rows to return (1-500). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: max_results

date_preset.description: The reporting window the figures cover.

list_ad_accounts.description: List every Meta ad account the connected user can advertise on, with each account's currency, status and lifetime spend.
list_ad_accounts.name: list_ad_accounts

parameters.description: How many rows to return (1-500). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: max_results

list_ad_creatives.description: List the saved ad creatives in an ad account: the headline, body text and thumbnail each ad can run.
list_ad_creatives.name: list_ad_creatives

parameters.description: The ad account whose creatives to list.
parameters.name: ad_account_id

parameters.description: How many rows to return (1-500). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: max_results

list_ad_sets.description: List the ad sets in an ad account, or just the ones in a single campaign, with each ad set's budget and targeting.
list_ad_sets.name: list_ad_sets

parameters.description: The ad account whose ad sets to list.
parameters.name: ad_account_id

parameters.description: Only list the ad sets in this campaign. Leave empty to list every ad set in the account.
parameters.name: campaign_id

parameters.description: Only return rows with this delivery status. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: How many rows to return (1-500). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: max_results

list_ads.description: List the ads in an ad account, or just the ones in a single ad set, with each ad's status and creative.
list_ads.name: list_ads

parameters.description: The ad account whose ads to list.
parameters.name: ad_account_id

parameters.description: Only list the ads in this ad set. Leave empty to list every ad in the account.
parameters.name: ad_set_id

parameters.description: Only return rows with this delivery status. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: How many rows to return (1-500). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: max_results

list_campaigns.description: List the campaigns in an ad account, with each campaign's objective, delivery status and budget.
list_campaigns.name: list_campaigns

parameters.description: The ad account whose campaigns to list.
parameters.name: ad_account_id

parameters.description: Only return rows with this delivery status. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: How many rows to return (1-500). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: max_results

list_facebook_pages.description: List the Facebook Pages you manage, with the id each one needs when you create an ad creative. Pages you can run ads for are marked, because Meta refuses a creative naming a Page you cannot advertise for.
list_facebook_pages.name: list_facebook_pages

parameters.description: How many rows to return (1-500). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: max_results

update_ad.description: Rename an ad, or pause or resume it. Only the fields you fill in are changed.
update_ad.name: update_ad

parameters.description: The ad to update.
parameters.name: ad_id

parameters.description: A new name for the ad. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: A new status. Leave empty to keep the current one.
parameters.name: status

update_ad_set.description: Rename an ad set, pause or resume it, or change its daily budget. Only the fields you fill in are changed.
update_ad_set.name: update_ad_set

parameters.description: The ad set to update.
parameters.name: ad_set_id

parameters.description: A new name for the ad set. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: A new status. Leave empty to keep the current one.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: A new daily budget in the account's currency. Leave empty to keep the current budget.
parameters.name: daily_budget

update_campaign.description: Rename a campaign, pause or resume it, or change its daily budget. Only the fields you fill in are changed.
update_campaign.name: update_campaign

parameters.description: The campaign to update.
parameters.name: campaign_id

parameters.description: A new name for the campaign. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: A new status. Leave empty to keep the current one.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: A new daily budget in the account's currency, for example, 25. Leave empty to keep the current budget.
parameters.name: daily_budget

description: Build and manage Meta ad campaigns (campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives) and read how they are delivering.
